title: Realm-pool magic (module_data.magic)
description: A caster character's module_data.magic sub-object under core/realm-pool-v1 (ADR-0005 / RFC-0008). The magic_pool itself lives in module_data.character_sheet (max = Will x 2); this object holds the caster's binding + accessible realms. Enforcement is deferred (same posture as character_sheet); shipped as the authored contract.

binding.description: The caster's source, assigned from fiction. 'deity:<slug>' for a Cleric (e.g. 'deity:the-mender') or 'tradition:<slug>' for a Mage (e.g. 'tradition:elementalist').

patron_standing.description: Cleric only: standing with the patron deity, 0-10. DM-writable (shifts as the cleric honors or violates the deity's tenets). No mechanical spell-lockout in v0.1 (fall deferred).

realms.description: The realms this caster can draw from, derived from the binding: a deity's 2 domain_realms, or a tradition's [primary, secondary]. Secondary-realm spells cost +1 pool.
